name: computer-use
title: Computer Use
description: Let a chat's bots see and use apps and the browser on this server's computer, through cua-driver.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: List the desktop and browser tools Computer Use offers, or pass a tool name to inspect its schema. Computer Use restricts the accepted arguments.

tool.description: A tool's name, such as get_window_state. Omit to list every tool.

tools.name: call
tools.description: Run one cua-driver tool on the server's desktop or an exact browser tab. Use describe to discover supported calls. Screenshots come back as images. Actions require approval.

args.description: Its arguments, as describe lists them.
